- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Encoding non-masked portions of a sample and using a convolutional decoder to predict target representations for masked portions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Amortizing computational overhead by reusing each target for multiple masked versions of a training sample.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Inverse block masking strategy preserves contiguous regions of the sample to provide more context for student predictions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Training targets are based on averaging top K FFN blocks of the teacher.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Teacher weights are an exponentially moving average of student encoder weights.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Asymmetric encoder/decoder architecture with student encoder only encoding unmasked patches or time-steps.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Random Gaussian noise used to represent masked tokens.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Student network trained to reconstruct contextualized target representation of teacher network.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Predictions of student network used to update teacher network.
